paper_title: Search for Axion dark matter with the QUAX-LNF tunable haloscope
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, 90% single-sided C.L. upper limit
notes: QUAX-LNF haloscope, TM010 cavity at 8.83 GHz, 8 T field. Best limit g_agamma < 0.882e-13 GeV^-1 (90% CL) over mass range 36.52413-36.5511 ueV. The limit varies with mass near cavity resonances but the paper reports the best-case value; encoded as horizontal line spanning the probed mass window since detailed per-frequency values not tabulated.
